notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature token.
Your life total is at least 2.
description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Nadier's Nightblade triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.
